test_title: PYST 4 - SSC CHSL 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 13 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A sum of money doubles itself in 8 years at a certain rate of simple interest. In how many years will it become five times itself at the same rate?
solution:
**Given:**

Sum doubles in 8 years

Simple Interest

**Formula used:**

SI ∝ Time

Amount = Principal + SI

**Calculations:**

⇒ In 8 years, amount = 2P

⇒ SI in 8 years = P

⇒ So, SI per year = P ÷ 8

⇒ To become 5P, SI needed = 5P − P = 4P

⇒ Time = 4P ÷ (P ÷ 8)

⇒ Time = 4P × 8 ÷ P

⇒ Time = 32 years

**∴ Required time = 32 years**
